notes.title: New information on Crown of Greed release window
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, your Grace! 👑[/h1]
[hr][/hr]
Today, we bring you a single, yet crucial announcement. Countless players have been asking about the date of the full release of Crown of Greed, and we believe in keeping our conversations with you clear and honest. That’s why it’s time to address the most frequently asked question across our Social Media, Discord server, and Steam discussions.


[h2]The Crown of Greed release window is set on early 2026[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/040c65c16916b4da51a08b64bd885af45172c5c5.png[/img]

This means you'll reclaim the throne of Rodovia once again in the early months of next year. While that may seem far off, we’re confident that time will pass in the blink of an eye. We are very keen to give you the opportunity to play Crown of Greed as soon as possible, but this will not happen until we are sure that we have done everything in our power to make the title as polished, extended and fun as possible. Speaking of which...


[h2]Warm reception of the Demo and further decisions[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
The Demo version was met with great enthusiasm by players worldwide. Beyond the wealth of valuable feedback we’ve received, this positive reception was an important message in itself. And so, thanks to the successful Demo version, we gained additional resources to develop the project even further than originally planned. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/dbbb4a0019eb089a5f915477d2b5aa5dccca40bb.gif[/img]

Know, that [b]it was you - the community[/b] - who had a huge role in this important decision, and that we will continue to do whatever we can to listen to your opinions and try to implement your cool ideas into the game. Yet again, you've demonstrated your passion and unwavering support, and for that, we are truly grateful.


[url=https://discord.gg/zzPZYTF4bE][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/5bd7570ac75752cdf33a3579a783ea3f93dfdc3a.png[/img]
[/url]

[h2]What do we plan to achieve with this extra time?[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Every extra day is worth its weight in gold here, and we gained quite a few of them! And although we are still in the planning phase, and many details are yet to be finalized, we can already share that you can look forward to:

➡️ a set of completely new systems and mechanics designed to differentiate Crown of Greed from the Majesty series while still remaining true to the core gameplay concepts. Examples? Here we go:
- the option to give names to your favorite heroes, transfer them between scenarios or even resurrect fallen champions 
- day & night system
- the new option allowing you to choose your royal banner
- the totally new decrees system, which we will tell you more about in the future. For now, we can spoil that they increase the variation between subsequent scenarios... according to your choices

➡️ at least one additional hero class and two new enemy type compared to what we planned for the original release. Once again, we don't want to spoil them yet, as they need an appropriate presentation, but these are the classes you asked for most often in your suggestions

➡️ extensive campaign system
- numerous, varied scenarios, each with its own setting, variables and victory conditions
- additional "tower defense" scenarios focusing on defending the base, which is attacked by increasingly larger waves of enemies
- a new system that will allow you to spend earned points between scenarios to unlock new buildings, technologies, heroes skills and so on; now you will be able to shape your own unique playstyle!

➡️ lots of balance changes, better AI of player units and enemies, tons of general improvements and fixes, a number of other minor changes or additions

➡️ numerous Quality of Life changes

➡️ animation improvements

➡️ sounds and audio improvements


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/6e44ec63d335e7e57bd697963c25e742ed7aa1f0.gif[/img]

[h2]More info coming soon![/h2]
[hr][/hr]
As time goes by, we will certainly be able to share more details and specific information. We'd love to tell you all about them in the future, so be sure to stay tuned! We trust that the additional production time for Crown of Greed will greatly enhance its quality, and we hope this decision will be met with your support.

[b]Thank you, your Grace![/b]



[h3]Have you seen our other games?[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
[b]Viking Frontiers[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304430/Viking_Frontiers/

[b]Builders of Greece[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1273100/Builders_of_Greece/

[b]Gimle: The Broken Prophecy[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1765920/Gimle_The_Broken_Prophecy

notes.title: Demo summary and a few words from the team 📜
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, your Grace! 👑[/h1]
[hr][/hr]
The last few weeks have been a real rollercoaster for our entire team. [b]Until the last moment[/b] before the release of the Crown of Greed Demo, we refined and improved the gameplay to make your adventure in the world of Rodovia as fun and immersive as possible.

We raced against time to get rid of the most frustrating bugs, balance the economy and combat system, improve NPC behavior, or add new cool features to the game, so that we are ready to take part in the Steam RTS festival. And now... we see that[b] it was worth it [/b]😃


[h2]A huge thank you to our community 💪[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/fb5395601e17cd28845c66b63c58fea046839663.png[/img]

As usual, you have proven what a great community you are, everyone. We received so many words of support, useful feedback, great suggestions and reports that they [b]almost overwhelmed us![/b] 

We spent long hours analyzing every single opinion you sent us, resulting in the first two Demo Hotfixes. What's more, we were extremely happy to see your reviews on Steam, thanks to which we managed to [b]obtain the "very positive" rating 🤩[/b]

Seeing such great enthusiasm, you can be sure that this is [b]not the end[/b] of our work on improving and developing the Crown of Greed project. With that in mind, let's talk about our plans for the future.


[h2]What's coming next? 🛠️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
It's too early to promise anything for sure, but a few elements came up [b]among your feedback most often,[/b] which indicated the direction we want to go.

➡️ First of all - more [b]missions and a campaign[/b]. The world of Rodovia is a diverse, dangerous, but also beautiful land that has much to offer. We will invite you to explore (and conquer) all its corners! 

➡️ [b]Voice Acting[/b] - we realize that it is currently somewhat generic, and we will do our best to improve it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/a3ec2088e588a2ecfa0efe82b2e7bff35811bf17.png[/img]

➡️ [b]UI and QOL improvements[/b] - thanks to your feedback, we know how much these elements affect the fun of the game. We will work hard to make it as clear and useful as possible.

➡️ Balance changes - strength of monsters, gaining experience by heroes, amount of taxes, HP of buildings, spawning rates and... and everything else [b]will be further analyzed and refined.[/b]

➡️ Among your requests, there was often a question about [b]resurrecting your favorite heroes[/b] and transferring them between scenarios. We will make it happen!

➡️ We are working on a few new mechanics and [b]an innovative system[/b] which will further diversify the gameplay. We are currently exploring a few [b]intriguing ideas[/b], so that Crown of Greed will have even more to offer!

We could go on and on, and list even more changes, such as the deeper relations between heroes and the player, new kinds of monsters, spells and buildings, but [b]we are sure you get the idea[/b]. The game will certainly evolve and expand, and we will discuss all the novelties in more detail in the near future.


[url=https://discord.gg/GnTYDgBAHy][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/5bd7570ac75752cdf33a3579a783ea3f93dfdc3a.png[/img]
[/url]


[h2]For now - let's enjoy the Demo and try to beat it in the Nightmare mode 💀[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Can you believe that some of you managed to do it? We're honestly surprised that you were able to [b]beat the game on the hardest difficulty setting...[/b] which is another lesson for us. We will be sure to prepare even more challenges for you in the future, with even more deadly enemies and surprising events. Once again, thank you, everyone. [b]We will speak to you soon![/b]


[h3][b]Good luck in Rodovia, Rulers [/b]
[/h3]



[h3]Have you seen our other games?[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
[b]Viking Frontiers[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304430/Viking_Frontiers/

[b]Builders of Greece[/b]

notes.title: Demo Hotfix 0.1.7 is live
notes.content:
[h1]Good news, your Grace! 👑[/h1]
[hr][/hr]
The first Crown of Greed Demo Hotfix was released just two days ago... and [b]we are not slowing down! [/b]We are pleased to announce that thanks to the commitment of our team and your wonderful, helpful feedback, we have managed to prepare a completely new update - namely [b]Hotfix 0.1.7.[/b]

This time, our main goal was to get rid of the bugs and issues that you reported to us via Steam and Discord server. As you can see from the list below, we did quite well! [b]However, bugfixing is not the only change[/b] we have prepared. It's time to take a look at the... 👇 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/5b815e135a6f35dead13099bf99882672c2bef98.png[/img]

[h2]Crown of Greed Demo - Hotfix 0.1.7 Notes:[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
• Increased melee range for all units
• Implemented new music tracks
• The colors of buildings on the minimap are now more visible
• Improved the heroes' escape system mechanics
• Treasure stacking now has a greater range
• Improved the rotation of the Arena building
• Improved heroes AI for collecting treasures
• Fixed a bug that caused insufficient rewards when the reward was still high
• Fixed combat sounds that were not playing properly
• Fixed a glitch that allowed infinite gold generation
• Fixed the functionality of the Tactician trait
• Fixed a bug where characters would get stuck on treasures
• Fixed a bug preventing heroes from visiting the Arena
• Fixed a bug preventing workers from repairing buildings
• Fixed gray portraits for quests and heroes
• Fixed a bug causing unwanted behavior from destroyed buildings
• Fixed hero movement at the Rally Point
• Fixed defense quest AI—heroes no longer travel between quests of the same type
• Fixed a bug where the Guardian could not reach a destroyed tower
• The Action Panel is no longer disabled when opening castle, flag, or cemetery panels
• Changed keybinds for some panels
• Updated the GuideBook with current keybinds
• Adjusted main menu background scaling and banner placement on widescreen resolutions


We hope that the new Hotfix will make your experience [b]even more immersive and fun[/b]. As always, we await your opinions, suggestions and cool ideas on our Social Media channels, Discord server and Steam Discussions 📣 Thank you!


[h3][b]Good luck in Rodovia, Rulers [/b]
[/h3]

notes.title: Enjoy the Crown of Greed Demo on Steam RTS Fest ⚔️
notes.content:
[h1]The time has come, your Grace! 👑[/h1]
[hr][/hr]
We hope you’ve missed your days in the gloomy, harsh, and dangerous realm of Rodovia, dear Kings, as today its gates swing wide open once again. [b]The release of our game's Demo[/b] marks another significant milestone in the development of our project, and we’re thrilled to share it with you today, coinciding with the launch of the Steam Real-Time Strategy Fest. 

With the great enthusiasm and hope in our hearts, we invite you to join us in this epic adventure, and try to seize control over your [b]loyal subjects and independent heroes[/b] ✊ [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3307570/Crown_of_Greed_Demo/][b]Dedicated Demo Steam Page »[/b][/url]


[h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3307570/Crown_of_Greed_Demo/]The Crown of Greed Demo is now live[/url] 💥[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3307570/Crown_of_Greed_Demo/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/c33c7318b4f6e4326bdb6d32adb78d1f3cc4a204.png[/img]
[/url]
[b]Those of you who took part in our Playtest[/b] are certainly wondering what new things await you this time, however we will come back to this topic a little bit later. Let us start by [b]welcoming the new players,[/b] who haven't played Crown of Greed before and don't really know what they can expect. Here are some tips to help you understand the rules you'll have to follow:


[h4]▶️ Economy[/h4]
Upon entering the world of Rodovia, you’ll face the task of building your first foothold, which will provide your subjects with shelter and grant you priceless gold from taxes 🪙 Each building you have built, such as a Forge, Market, Inn and others will generate gold collected by the Tax Collector. Unless your Collector is torn to shreds by wolves, giant spiders, devils or other dangerous creatures, your treasury will be full.

[h4]▶️ Spendings[/h4]
You can use the money earned from taxes, running trading posts and destroying enemy nests to expand your city and defend it with a system of defense towers. You can also build Hero habitats where you can recruit the bold adventurers and upgrade their abilities. 

[h4]▶️ Heroes[/h4]
Nothing speaks to the courage and conscience of heroes like shiny coins. You can't control them directly, but you can pay them to encourage them to perform various types of contracts, such as reconnaissance, defense of a selected area, or attack. With successful contracts, your heroes will gain experience and develop their skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/cd63734bb3a80b15165e7253b8393149fb9a9a0b.gif[/img]

[h4]▶️ Enemies[/h4]
Your city is regularly attacked by various creatures. To prevent this, you must develop appropriate defense systems and deploy your heroes to destroy enemy-generating habitats. Be cautious, though, as enraged foes may launch large, coordinated attacks on your borders.

[h4]▶️ Player's actions[/h4]
You, as a powerful Ruler, can also take part in battle using the spell system. You can also manage the power of a coin. It's up to you how much gold you offer your heroes for completing a given mission. Can you find the balance and make them obey you?


[h2]Differences between the Playest version and Demo ⚒️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
If you have already had the opportunity to play Crown of Geed, this section will certainly interest you the most. Let's dive into the changes and novelties we have crafted for you in the Demo version, shall we?


[h4]Novelties:[/h4]
- New buildings: Arena and Library
- New flag status panel (showing Heroes' interactions with your contracts proposals)
- The campaign map
- Improved player action panel
- New panel allowing you to manage the costs of contracts 
- New characters' status icons 
- New skills VFX and effects


[h4]Fixes and balance changes:[/h4]
- Addition of numerous new tooltips and tooltips improvements
- The player's spells Cure and Stone Shield have been changed to be area-based instead of single-targeted
- Heroes are now more willing to take on missions
- Heroes now spend a little more time wandering outside the city
- Reduced the number of maximum heroes of one type that player can recruit from 3 to 2
- Additional balance of skills and stats for almost every unit in the game
- Player buildings health points increased
- Changes to the narration and map events 
- Reduced the amount of gold generated in buildings
- Changed prices of some technologies
- Increased range of vision for units and buildings 
- Reduced speed of construction and repair of buildings by workers
- Additional optimization of given systems and materials
- Fixed or added new SFX to characters and their abilities
- The camera can be zoomed-out further than before
- Fixed bug causing the characters to get stuck


[h4]We wish you great adventures and the best of luck, Rulers![/h4]

notes.title: What's next? About our plans for the Crown of Greed 👑
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, your Grace! 👑[/h1]
[hr][/hr]
As you know, the Steam Playtest for Crown of Greed has come to a close, and... [b]we’re amazed with the outcome[/b] 🤩 We've collected a lot of valuable feedback that’s already helping us identify areas for improvement and polish as we continue working on the game. 

[b]What's more[/b], the vast majority of you rated the Playtest version positively and expressed your willingness to play more! 

Your support, enthusiasm, and thoughtful suggestions have been truly inspiring and have reinforced our commitment to delivering the best title possible. Rest assured, [b]the journey is far from over[/b], and we’re excited to keep you updated as Crown of Greed evolves.


[h2]What awaits us in the future?[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/8458103aaec4c4ee00bdb222c9275d69b756fa90.gif[/img]

After a successful Playtest, it will soon be time for bolder steps. We have been planning to release a [b]Demo version[/b] 👑 for quite some time, and we think we will be ready to do so in the near future. Right now, we just want to tease you with this plan, but as soon as more detailed information becomes available, we will be happy to [b]tell you all about it[/b]!

[url=https://discord.gg/GnTYDgBAHy][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/05be7083a470dc900670c4004230a42299f3cddb.png[/img]
[/url]

[h2]More about the Demo version[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
As we mentioned above, it is too early to talk about details, but we do not want to leave you unsatisfied 😉 For now, [b]we can tell you that[/b] the new playable build will feature missing tooltips, new sounds and special skill effects, new helpful icons, improved player skill panel and lots of balance changes.

The other huge task we have to tackle is [b]solving bugs.[/b] You reported quite a lot of them to us by Steam, Social Media, Discord and Feedback Forms (for which we thank you very much!), so our team will certainly not be bored. If we manage to get rid of the most important issues quickly enough, we will try to add some new things to the game, for example [b]new buildings and hero skills.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/d336805b4cce922e54a44dd38ad4409909c0afcb.gif[/img]


[h2]When you will have an opportunity to play again?[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
This one is tricky, as developing such a deep title as Crown of Greed is full of surprises, cool new ideas and refinements. Nevertheless, we already have a pretty well-defined plan 🤓 are you ready to get hyped?

Making a long story short - we will do our best to get back to you with a [b]Demo version in the following weeks[/b] (and sooner than you think!). Be sure to stay tuned, join our Discord and follow our Social Media channels - this way you won't miss this awesome event and once again take control over your fantasy kingdom in Crown of Greed.

[b]Thank you, everyone! 
[/b]

notes.title: Playtest Patch 0.1.4 🛠️ and upcoming Demo
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, your Grace! 👑[/h1]
[hr][/hr]
All good things come to an end someday, and this also applies to our Playtest. On Monday morning, the gates of Rodovia will close as we shift our focus to analyzing key insights that will guide the future development of Crown of Greed.

[h3][b]But don't worry - we have two exciting updates to brighten the mood! 🤩[/b][/h3]

1. Based on your feedback, we have just published the last, fourth Patch for the game

2. We are happy to announce that... you will soon have another opportunity to play the game, this time in the[b] Demo[/b] version!

We’ll share all the details about the [b]Demo version[/b] in a dedicated announcement, but for now, we just want you to know what's coming next 📣 Stay tuned for more updates!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/3278502f35bc179edeead01ed0cbd48fd1b86079.png[/img]

[h2]Playtest Patch 0.1.4 Notes:[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
• Fixed a bug that caused respawned workers to be blocked after being killed while working

• Fixes to the Scouting order contract, fixes to the operation of order contracts 
• Fixed translation issues occurring after changing the language of the game
• The option to open the ended contract panel has been disabled


[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
• Added a new traits tooltip to the character panel 
• Added new tooltips to order flags
• Improvements to the interaction of newly constructed buildings and environmental elements


[h3]Balance:[/h3]
•  Increase the berserker's fight-engage range



[h2]Please note 📜[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Keep in mind that this is only a[b] "work-in-progress"[/b] version of the game, the main goal of which is to present the overall concept of this project and its novelties. Remember, that at this stage you may encounter some bugs and problems, as the title is still in development. Crown of Greed is sure to receive [b]numerous patches[/b], most of them based on your feedback.

notes.title: Playtest Patch 0.1.3 🛠️
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, your Grace! 👑[/h1]
[hr][/hr]
Two Patches for the Playtest version are already behind us, but [b]we are not slowing down![/b] Today we have prepared another, third Patch, which continues our mission to polish and improve the Crown of Greed project.

New [b]players from all over the world[/b] are constantly joining our Playtest, and their feedback allows us to plan our next steps 📜 And so, without further ado, let's check what changes await us in the latest update.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/ba8cf209a41fc427f540c9efab20467e93a229a0.png[/img]

[h2]Playtest Patch 0.1.3 Notes:[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
• Fixed a bug that caused monsters to hide in their habitats too soon after combat
• Fixed contract panel closing when any non-targeted contract was completed
• Fixed a bug that caused a player to be unable to open the habitat panel when his contract panel was open
• Fixes to the Marketplace and the Heroes' equipment. Now, heroes can't own more than 1 stack of a single item
• Toggling technology tooltips in the Building Panel has been fixed, and they now display the required gold status properly
• Fixes to other technology related tooltips


[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
• Additional events for high difficulty levels 
• In the Blacksmith panel, all technologies are now visible (but blocked if the player does not meet the requirements)
• Treasure chest models are now bigger


[h3]Balance:[/h3]
• Adjustments to gold generation in buildings (reduced in all buildings, increased in Trading Posts) 
• Undead Warrior, Crossbowman and Captain are now stronger
• Rogue agility stat is now nerfed (lower chance to dodge)
• Heroes now stay in combat longer and start running away after losing more health points than before



[h2]Please note 📜[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Keep in mind that this is only a[b] "work-in-progress"[/b] version of the game, the main goal of which is to present the overall concept of this project and its novelties. notes.title: Playtest Patch 0.1.2 🛠️
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, your Grace! 👑[/h1]
[hr][/hr]
Another day, another Patch to the game! Our entire team is doing its best to respond to your reports as quickly as possible and implement appropriate fixes to the Crown of Greed Playtest. We still receive a huge amount of feedback, which [b]helps us a lot [/b]in our task to polish the game, so keep it coming, ok?

Today we managed to get rid of several bugging bugs (pun intended) and introduce many improvements, including a new, very important option - [b]difficulty levels[/b]. Let's take a look 👀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/25b736866ee96f1383cf6cc88fce5a221670b451.png[/img]

[h2]Playtest Patch 0.1.2 Notes:[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
• Fixed a bug that caused heroes belonging to a group to get stuck in a city
• Fixed a bug that caused heroes to get stuck in the Market
• Fixed a bug that caused the entire map to be cleared from the fog of war
• Fixed an issue that caused heroes not to perform the scouting missions
• Fixed an issue that caused the notification list to block or stutter
• Fixes to the re-built buildings' prices 
• Bear material fix


[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
• Adjustments to the tier 3 towers prices
• Adjustments to enemies' habitats health points
• Developed technologies disappear from the forge panel
• Added a new button that allows to return to the previous panel in the castle panel
• Heroes can't own more than 1 stack of a single item (e.g., a maximum of 8 potions) 
• The task panel is now more clear
• Buttons in the upper right corner of the screen are easier to read


[h3]Balance:[/h3]
• Added an option that allows players to change the difficulty of the game
• Health Potion now has a shorter cooldown
• Spells range increased
• Spells power increased
• Reduced threat levels to enemies and their habitats
• Guards are now more durable (increased HP)
• Some character models have been enlarged
• Monster attack waves are now slightly weaker, but some monsters deal additional damage
• Increased cooldown between attacks of some monsters
• Heroes now need less time to learn new skills


[h2]Please note 📜[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Keep in mind that this is only a[b] "work-in-progress"[/b] version of the game, the main goal of which is to present the overall concept of this project and its novelties. Remember, that at this stage you may encounter some bugs and problems, as the title is still in development. Crown of Greed is sure to receive [b]numerous patches[/b], most of them based on your feedback.

notes.title: Playtest Patch 0.1.1 is here 🛠️
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, your Grace! 👑[/h1]
[hr][/hr]
Thanks to your awesome feedback, we managed to prepare the very first [b]Patch to the game[/b]. Your reports are coming to us in a wide stream on our Discord server, Steam discussions and Social Media, for which we are very grateful. You have proven once again that we can count on your support and enthusiasm. 🤩 [b]Well done! [/b]

And so, based on your feedback, we are introducing a number of improvements and fixes to the Crown of Greed Playtest version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41063387/b8ada22dfe84788bbaf8e4a4e2425be14f185cd6.png[/img]

[h2]Playtest Patch 0.1.1 Notes:[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
• Fixed an issue with tax collectors and workers disappearing
• Fixed an issue with heroes not being assigned to missions for more challenging habitats
• Fixed an issue causing overlapping of different panels on the right side of the screen
• Fixed a bug with missing graphics for certain items
• Fixed a bug with icons in hero headquarters not disappearing after being recruited
• Fixed a bug with caravans traveling to the most recently built marketplace instead of the nearest one
• Fixed a bug with characters visible in the fog of war

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
• The minimap is now bigger
• Missing descriptions have been added
• Changes to the content of tooltips
• Adjustment to the minimum FPS setting in the game options
• Added the option to change anti-aliasing settings in the game
• Lower-level heroes will now have different skins
• Some visual effects have been enlarged for better readability
• Updates to the Guidebook
• The Alt key now displays additional information about buildings
• Increased width of the mission panel and hero list

[h3]Balance:[/h3]
• Tower prices have been increased
• The number of enemies generated on the map has been increased
• The number of monster habitats has been increased
• Some enemies now deal more damage 


[h2]Please note 📜[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Keep in mind that this is only a[b] "work-in-progress"[/b] version of the game, the main goal of which is to present the overall concept of this project and its novelties. Remember, that at this stage you may encounter some bugs and problems, as the title is still in development. Crown of Greed is sure to receive [b]numerous patches[/b], most of them based on your feedback. Next step - improvements to the AI of heroes who get stuck near the marketplace and bugs related to map discovery.
